Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Cherrie Upholstered Gliding Swivel Chair, 34"W, Chimney
Colors: Chimney
Materials: plush
This plush upholstered swivel chair is the perfect addition to any living space. The smooth gliding function and rounded sides and back mean this chair exudes easy comfort. Charcoal-colored upholstery provides durability and easy cleaning. The seat cushion is reversible for longer wear. This item is made to order just for you 34"W x 36"D x 33"H; seat height: 21"H; seat depth: 20"D; back height: 33"H Sturdy wood frame with polyester upholstery Smooth swivel gliding function makes this chair more versatile. Seat cushion is removable and reversible. No assembly required Vacuum or wipe with a dry cloth. Spot clean if needed. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
